guards: files already over 1000 lines may not grow, and an improvement must be locked in rather than left at the old high-water mark

poisonPill.why: A baseline understating every governed file by 500 lines — the tree as it would look if all of them had grown. Not hypothetical: measured over the 60 days to 2026-09-04, two decompositions removed 3,652 lines and were outpaced by 4,551 lines of unmanaged growth across 11 other files, one of them AFTER its decomposition was accepted.
